name: Anointing Your Home
overview: Scripture reveals that anointing with oil holds sacred significance, symbolizing consecration and God's presence, as seen when Jacob poured oil on a stone to mark a holy place (Genesis 28:18). The detailed instructions for creating holy anointing oil in Exodus (30:25, 30:31) emphasize its sanctity and ongoing use among God's people. While anointing signifies blessing and protection, the Bible also warns against engaging with occult practices (Leviticus 20:6), affirming that true security comes from trusting the Lord, who promises that no weapon formed against His servants shall prosper (Isaiah 54:17).
